pageTitle: Klacks for Facility & Cleaning Services in Switzerland | aveGAV Cleaning & Split Shifts

hero.badge: For facility & cleaning services in Switzerland
hero.subtitle: Klacks allocates sites, routes and split shifts efficiently — with the 42-hour week of the aveGAV for the cleaning sector taken into account automatically.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks roster grid for Swiss cleaning teams and sites

items.title: Keeping to the 42-hour week
items.text: The generally binding collective labour agreement for cleaning in German-speaking Switzerland (aveGAV Reinigung) sets weekly working time at 42 hours for a 100% workload — tedious to check by hand across changing teams and sites.

items.title: Breaks in split shifts
items.text: Split assignments in the morning and evening require an unpaid break of at least 15 minutes once working time reaches 5.5 hours — easily overlooked.

items.title: Short-notice cancellations by customers
items.text: If a customer cancels at short notice, an obligation to continue paying wages may arise — scheduling should generally keep this in view.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off Swiss facility services
solutions.subtitle: From the optimised route to monitored weekly working time — everything works together.

items.title: Site routes optimised
items.text: Klacks puts the sites in an order that keeps journeys short — by car, bike or on foot.

items.title: 42-hour week monitored automatically
items.text: Klacks continuously checks whether weekly working time per 100% workload is kept — in line with the aveGAV for the cleaning sector.

items.title: Breaks as a block in the round
items.text: The statutory break in split assignments from 5.5 hours of working time can be placed in the round as a fixed or movable block; Klacks does not check the break requirement itself.

items.title: Teams allocated flexibly
items.text: Changing line-ups, temporary staff and holidays: Klacks keeps track and suggests suitable allocations.

items.title: Matching qualifications
items.text: Specialist cleaning, machinery, security areas: only suitably qualified staff are allocated.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: “Plan the sites in Kreis 4 for tomorrow morning” is all it takes — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks optimises route and team.

example.title: Split shift, break, one plan
example.text: Klacks plans the sites as a round; you add the statutory break from 5.5 hours of working time straight away as a fixed or movable block.
